prompt:

Subject: One flat paint brush of exactly this width: Espesor 5/8 pulgada; ancho 4 pulgadas. Straight bristle edge, realistic separate bristles, a securely crimped steel ferrule and plain polished wooden handle; thickness of brush 5/8 inch. Width must visibly match the requested variant, not a round artist brush. No brand styling.
Style: realistic original high-detail 3D/studio illustration, convincing material texture and anatomy, white seamless background, soft contact shadow, entire object(s) inside frame with generous margins, 70-80% image occupancy, three-quarter view suitable for a hardware store. Not manufacturer photography; commercial identity cannot be certified. No brand name, logo, product code, price, arbitrary measurements text or fake packaging print. Only small bottom caption exactly "Ilustración referencial". No decorative extra tools, people or props. Render this SKU separately; do not collage different variants.
